name: MetaProperties
description: Represents a collection of properties describing the metadata stored in a document.
example:
Function ValidateMetaProperty(ByVal metaProps As MetaProperties) As String
Dim result As String

result = metaProps(1).Validate
ValidateMetaProperty = result
End Function

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the MetaProperties object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the MetaProperties object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Gets a MetaProperty object from the MetaProperties collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Gets a Long indicating the number of items in the MetaProperties collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the MetaProperties object. Read-only.

properties.name: SchemaXml
properties.description: Gets the schema XML for the MetaProperties object. Read-only.

methods.name: GetItemByInternalName
methods.description: Gets a property's value specifying its name as opposed to its index value.

parameters.name: InternalName
parameters.description: Contains the name of the property.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates all of the properties in a MetaProperties collection object according to a schema.
